# Course Structure

This course covers the path from raw wrist-worn accelerometry to reproducible analysis: device and study design, reading and processing raw signals, activity metrics, analysis and summaries, and quality control. Throughout, it distinguishes observed data from inserted, filtered, resampled, or inferred values.

## Slide Decks

| Module | Main question | Teaching dataset |
|---|---|---|
| [1. Accelerometer Devices and Studies](01-accelerometer-devices-and-studies.qmd) | What do accelerometers measure, and how are wearable studies designed? | Raw device data and study examples |
| [2. Reading and Processing Data](02-reading-and-processing-data.qmd) | How do we read, inspect, calibrate, and process raw acceleration? | Raw time/x/y/z data |
| [3. Activity Metrics](03-activity-metrics.qmd) | How do ENMO, MAD, MIMS, counts, and steps summarize movement? | Raw acceleration segment |
| [4. Analysis and Summaries](04-analysis-and-summaries.qmd) | How do we visualize, summarize, and model minute-level activity? | NHANES minute-level data |
| [5. Future Directions](05-future-directions.qmd) |  Future directions for actigraphy and the field |  |
| [99. Reproducibility, QC, and Other Methods](99-reproducibility-and-qc.qmd) | How do we audit the pipeline and extend it to specialized methods? | Full example project |
